rule: amendment B-14 (post hoc), local computations; confirmatory verdict unchanged

b11_two_way_refit.note: B-11 B7 saved only the percentile interval of the ratio (no replicates)

B1.rule: B-14 B1 (addendum 2): (a) weights of B-13 B1(a) redrawn and checked; (b)(c) saved replicates; (d) normal approximation only; TOST p = max(Phi(L+/se+), 1 - Phi(L-/se-)); one-sided 95% upper limit of R = upper end of the 90% Fieller interval; Monte Carlo SD of percentile limits from 1,000 resamples of the replicates; injected OR by the curves of B-13 B2

B2.rule: B-14 B2 (addendum 2): corrected run, fixed models; (i) jackknife over location groups and over activations; (ii) studentized bootstrap over location groups with a robust variance per replicate; (iii) G* of Carter, Schnepel and Steigerwald (2017) for the location-group contributions; (iv) R without the two most influential groups of B-13 B6 and with equal weights per group, AOI and activation (Fieller intervals from 4,000 location-group replicates)

B5.rule: B-14 B5 (addendum 2): Brier scores of the reference arms and increments over the yardstick; corrected test (a) (4,000 location-group replicates) for M1s -> M3d and M1s -> M3s; corrected run's splits as specified, confirmatory code's splits for reference

B6.rule: B-14 B6 (addendum 2): gain of the record through settlements over its gain directly in the cell, same location-group replicates (4,000); 90% percentile interval over replicates with a positive denominator

B9.rule: B-14 B9 (addendum 2): pairs of B-13 B15; elevation of the cell holding the settlement point (GLO-30 mean) and drainage area of the nearest reach (v57); lower minus upper (log ratio for the area); sign test and location-group bootstrap (2,000)

B10.rule: B-14 B10 (addendum 2): final census of B-12 (v69_estimates.csv), unique valid name-effect rows that exclude the null; direction by family, class and quantity as in addendum 2

B11.rule: B-14 B11: the 2,000 pairs replicates (log odds ratio) of B-13 C2, uncapped EMS

B12.rule: B-14 B12: Brier skill increments relative to the training-side constant of B-12 B17 (primary split)

B15.rule: B-14 B15 (addendum 2): per AOI of the corrected run, delta BS = BS(M1c) - BS(M3n) and delta AUC = AUC(M3n) - AUC(M1c); R without each of the five most influential activations from B2(i)

B7.rule: B-14 B7 (addendum 2): logistic regression with a single intercept, standardised columns, cluster-robust by location group (v39.fit); EMS on the held-out cells of the stage-2 dumps of B-8 C2 (B-13 B8 estimator, and with the logit of the corrected run's M1c as the base); GFM on the planned GFM table with the logit of the held-out M1c of world_v2_gfm as the base

B3.rule: B-14 B3 (addendum 2): corrected run, fixed models; countries with activations, then activations within each drawn copy of a country (outer and inner alike); L rule = one-sided 95% upper limit of L+ below 0 and lower limit of L- above 0; upper-only rule = upper limit of L+ below 0

B13.rule: B-14 B13 (addendum 2): capped table and estimator of v55 (frozen lexicon reading); (i) riverine cover as a fractional response; (ii) typed AOIs only; (iii) log(1 + population) of the nearest settlement and the 10 m built-up share; (iv) planned GFM estimate with a leave-one-location-group-out jackknife

B14.rule: B-14 B14 (addendum 2): row counts of cells, features and landcover; P_d1 recomputed from the cell centre and the GeoNames coordinates of P_gid1 in the AOI's LAEA (agreement within 1 m)

B8.rule: B-14 B8 (addendum 2): lexicon edits with the class of the original entry; blocks; settlements nearest to an evaluable cell of the uncapped table; omitted elements by word; char, au and ab matches by country; precision and misses of the published two coders by block and form (Wilson 95%); gazetteer by country

B4.rule: B-14 B4 (addendum 2): pigeonhole bootstrap (Owen 2007): multinomial weights of location groups and of activations drawn independently, cell weight = product; stage 2 refitted on the dumps of B-8 C2 (design and signs of B-13 B1(b)(c))

B4d.rule: B-14 addendum 4 (after the B4 result): overlap of location groups and activations (corrected run, primary split) and the refitted B4 resamples with a robust z of delta BS above 4; descriptive
